parameters.text:
🤖 *SweetPea Admin Bot*
══════════════════════════

🔑 `/invite sweetpea` — Sweet Pea tier code (family/friends)
🌱 `/invite seedling` — Seedling tier code (manual override)
🌿 `/refer [fam|pea] <name>` — Referral code (bare `/refer` lists pending)

📋 `/pending` — Donors awaiting verification
✅ `/verify <id>` — Approve donor → generate code → email
❌ `/reject <id>` — Reject donor → email rejection

📊 `/status <username or email>` — Donor details
📧 `/resend <username or email>` — Reset password & resend
🚫 `/suspend <username or email>` — Disable access
🟢 `/unsuspend <username or email>` — Re-enable access

📜 `/list` — Active donors
👥 `/allsubs` — All donors
🔢 `/count` — Database dashboard

🔑 `/allcodes` — Every code
🟢 `/available` — Unused codes
🔴 `/usedcodes` — Redeemed codes
🔍 `/search <query>` — Find donor by name, username, or email

🗑️ `/delsub <username or email>` — Remove donor
🗑️ `/delcode <code>` — Remove code
🖥️ `/dbstatus` — Database health

🚨 `/incident <title>, <desc>` — Post an incident
✅ `/resolve <id>` — Resolve an incident

❓ `/help` — This menu

_Tip: for donor commands you can use either the username or the email address._
